benchmark: Librebase vs Supabase vector search — fresh run (Li HNSW engine, hnswlib-faithful, binary-heap ef search, normalized vectors)
method: warm index, sustained query stream; QPS excludes index build + payload I/O; ground truth = exact numpy top-10

librebase_li.engine: Li vector CLI (exact + HNSW), zero external deps

headline: At equal 100% recall@10, Li HNSW ef=40 = 4683 QPS vs pgvector ef=320/640 = 499/488 QPS (9.4x faster). Li maintains 100% recall at every ef; pgvector must raise ef (and lose QPS) to approach it. Li also beats pgvector at every ef level.
